blocks.title: Five seats, five altars · the drum hub gets two new fives in one afternoon
blocks.dek: Mike: 'set up 5 ai vs ai or even at minimum compute battle, what's neat and entertaining and pleasant to the ear.' Then: 'very fun, make some nouns drums tribute alters.' Two surfaces shipped same afternoon. /drum-quintet is a five-seat composition that always sounds musical. /drum-altars is a velvet shrine where five Nouns rotate every Monday.
